name: session-build
about: an earlier nib session: the build fails, and bun test still runs and lists 201 failures; under the cut budget
command: gofmt -l internal; go build ./... && go test ./internal/engine 2>&1 | tail -3; bun test 2>&1 | grep -E "^\(fail\)|pass$|fail$"
purpose: Build and run tests
expect: it builds and all tests pass; if not, the first error

name: session-e2e
about: an earlier nib session: nib hosting zemble end to end, 31 validation errors of handshake noise first; under the cut budget
command: go build -o /tmp/nib-e2e/nib ./cmd/nib && cd /tmp/nib-e2e && timeout 300 bun e2e.ts /tmp/nib-e2e/nib .../zemble ~/projects/nib '{"name":"zemble_search",...}' ...
purpose: End-to-end run of nib hosting zemble
expect: the tools list and each call's result without errors

name: session-go-test-break
about: an earlier nib session: go test ./... with six failing tests in two packages
command: gofmt -l . ; go build ./... && go test ./... 2>&1 | tail -40
purpose: Build and run Go tests to see breakage
expect: all pass; if not, which tests and why

name: session-bun-grep-fails
about: an earlier nib session: three failing bun tests with their expected and received values
command: bun test test/engine.test.ts -t "anchored match and context rows|the default gives none|definitions that did not ask" 2>&1 | grep -B3 -A14 "error:" | head -90
purpose: Show the three grep failures
expect: the three failures with expected and received

name: session-zemble-help
about: an earlier nib session: a repository's layout and two --help texts to read; every line is the point
command: cd ~/projects/external/zemble && ls && ls src/zemble && zemble --help 2>&1 | head -40; zemble search --help 2>&1 | head -40
purpose: Survey zemble's layout and CLI options
expect: the layout and every option

name: session-hook-usages
about: an earlier nib session: a recursive grep through the system program, every hit to read
purpose: Find hook registration usages and tests
expect: every place hooks are registered

name: gradle-browser
